app_info.subtitle: Verified stay offers
app_info.description: HemmaBo helps you discover host-owned vacation rental websites and cryptographically verify that a stay offer is genuinely signed by the host. Find host-owned homes by place and dates, check availability, and confirm the host's Vacation Rental Protocol (VRP) signature, then get a verified offer summary with a link to book directly with the host, on the host's own website. Vacation Rental Protocol is an open standard for host-signed stay offers. Anything transactional — reserving and paying — happens directly with the host, outside ChatGPT. HemmaBo is a verification layer, not a marketplace, and it takes no booking commission.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only queries the published-property catalog in Supabase and returns matching listings without modifying any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from the federation's private Supabase catalog and does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes free dates and minimum nightly price for a property by reading bookings and pricing rules without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only from the federation's private database and does not affect any external public system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite data and cannot perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads only public host-domain VRP discovery and JWKS documents to verify node conformance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches public host-domain endpoints (/.well-known/vacation-rental.json and JWKS) on the open web.
justifications.destructive_justification: Performs verification only and does not create, update, or delete any external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches and verifies a signed host-domain stay offer without mutating booking, payment, or profile data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls open host-domain VRP endpoints and validates Ed25519 signatures using the domain JWKS.
justifications.destructive_justification: Verification is read-only and returns the host's own website URL; it never creates a booking, checkout session, or payment.

test_cases.description: Discover host-owned vacation rentals by location and dates.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use HemmaBo to find direct-bookable host-owned vacation rentals in Skane for 6 guests from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns published host-owned property data from the federation with propertyId, host domain, and capacity. Does not create a booking, process a payment, or quote a final payable total, and does not present HemmaBo as an OTA, marketplace, or website builder.

test_cases.description: Check availability for a selected property (read-only).
test_cases.user_prompt: Check availability for property 3ef1d46d-5c23-46fe-86cb-8e714abf734f from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-17 for 6 guests.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns whether the selected property is available for the requested dates and suggests alternative dates if not, without creating any booking or payment.

test_cases.description: Verify a host domain's VRP trust metadata.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verify the vacation rental node villaakerlyckan.se before I trust its offer.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns VRP protocol version, discovery URL, JWKS URL, stay-offer endpoint, and signing-key details if verification succeeds. Read-only; creates no booking or payment.

test_cases.description: Show a cryptographically verified stay offer and hand off to the host's own website.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the verified stay offer for villaakerlyckan.se from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05 for 6 guests.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a fresh signed offer, signature verification, a summary of verified facts, and the host's own website URL where any booking or payment is completed. HemmaBo never creates a booking or checkout session inside ChatGPT.

negative_test_cases.description: Never book or take payment inside ChatGPT.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Just book and pay for the villaakerlyckan.se stay for me right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: HemmaBo does not create bookings, checkout sessions, or payments inside ChatGPT. It returns the host's own website URL and directs the user to complete any reservation and payment there.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger HemmaBo for chain hotels outside federation scope.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because HemmaBo covers host-owned vacation rentals, not chain hotels.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger HemmaBo for flights.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because flights are outside HemmaBo scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger HemmaBo for broad OTA-style hotel search.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because this is a broad hotel/OTA request outside HemmaBo direct host-domain scope.
